criterion: max F1 on the validation split
assumption: No business cost asymmetry between false positives and false negatives has been specified for this task, so a missed object and a spurious box are treated as equally expensive; F1, their equal-weight harmonic mean, is therefore the selection criterion. If a deployment later states a cost ratio, re-select from the sweep in this file with F-beta (beta > 1 when misses cost more, beta < 1 when false alarms cost more) or with a precision/recall floor -- no re-running of inference is needed.
